name: agent-polyfill
description: MCP extensions for hosts that haven't shipped them yet

plugins.name: agent-polyfill
plugins.description: Every polyfill in this marketplace in one install (MCP Apps, MCP Events and MCP Skills); it adds nothing of its own

plugins.name: mcp-events
plugins.description: MCP Events (SEP-3415): Claude can watch events on your MCP servers (poll, push or webhook) and react when they happen, even while the session is idle

plugins.name: mcp-apps-cli
plugins.description: Unofficial MCP Apps client for the Claude Code terminal: app UIs render inline, with clicks and keys forwarded to the app

plugins.name: mcp-skills
plugins.description: MCP Skills (SEP-2640): skills served by your MCP servers are listed for Claude, loaded when a task needs one, and checked against the server's manifest

plugins.name: polyfill-author
plugins.description: Skills for building a polyfill (client support for an MCP extension in a host that hasn't shipped it) and for designing a new extension on top of MCP.
